newsitem.title: USA: Great Atlantic recalls some chocolate bars.
newsitem.headline: Great Atlantic recalls some chocolate bars.

text.p: The Great Atlantic & Pacific Tea Co Inc said Thursday it was recalling 3.5-ounce bars of Master Choice Dark Bittersweet Chocolate, which it said could contain undeclared nut particles.

The company said nut particles which had not been listed as ingredients were found in several bars. It said the bars were distributed in retail food stores in 20 Eastern states but that no illnesses have been reported from them.
It said customers should return the bars to stores where they were bought for full refunds.
The company said it issued the recall because people who have allergies to nuts could face allergic reactions.
